home_meta_description: GameSearch — a premium Android app: game catalog, favorites, collections, ratings, and news feed in a refined dark interface.
home_hero_lead: Catalog, favorites, collections, ratings, and news — in a premium dark interface for people who live and breathe games.
home_benefits_lead: GameSearch brings together everything you need to track releases, manage your library, and stay close to the industry.
home_benefit_1_desc: Catalog, news, lists, and stats — no juggling a dozen services.
home_benefit_2_desc: Calm gradients, large cover art, and smooth transitions — perfect for late-night sessions.
home_benefit_3_desc: Favorites, collections, and ratings for any workflow — from backlog to completed.
home_benefit_4_desc: News feed with filters and genre tops — never miss what matters.
home_about_p1: GameSearch helps you discover games, build your library, and stay on top of industry news — in one place, without clutter.
home_about_p2: The interface is tuned for night sessions: calm gradients, large cover art, and fast navigation. Your profile shows progress and stats, while Favorites and Collections help you group releases the way you work.
home_about_p3: The news feed is easy to scan by date and topic; tops and picks let you explore games by genre and year.
home_fact_site_val: Questions to the developer and published answers
home_features_lead: Six core sections that turn your phone into a personal gaming hub.
home_feat_1_desc: Stats, charts, and progress across your game library.
home_feat_2_desc: Curated articles with date filters and comfortable reading.
home_feat_3_desc: Cover art, ratings, and quick access to beloved releases.
home_feat_4_desc: Custom game lists for any scenario or project.
home_feat_5_desc: Games by genre and year — discover something new every day.
home_feat_6_desc: Fast search with detailed game cards across the database.
home_how_1_desc: Install GameSearch from Google Play — free with no unnecessary permissions.
home_how_2_desc: Add games to favorites, create lists, and rate what you play.
home_how_3_desc: Read news, browse tops, and track your progress in the profile.
home_testimonial_1_text: Finally one app instead of five bookmarks. The dark UI is fire — cover art looks incredible.
home_testimonial_2_text: Collections and favorites are exactly what was missing. News with date filters is super handy.
home_testimonial_3_text: Profile stats motivate me to clear my backlog. Design feels premium.
home_faq_1_a: The app is available for Android via Google Play. Android 8.0 or newer is required.
home_faq_2_a: Yes — GameSearch is free to download and use for catalog, lists, and news features.
home_faq_3_q: Can I sync data across devices?
home_faq_3_a: Sync depends on your in-app account settings. Ask the developer — we reply in the Q&A section.
home_faq_4_q: How do I delete my account and data?
home_faq_4_a: Deletion is available in app settings or by email. See the account deletion page for details.
home_faq_5_q: How do I contact the developer?
home_faq_5_a: Use the Ask a question form on this site — answers are published openly.

delete_lead: Request removal of your GameSearch account from the app or by email. Below is how to do it and what happens to your data.
delete_how_p: You can delete your account in the app:
delete_step1: Open the app on your device and sign in if you use an account.
delete_step2: Go to your profile or Settings from the main navigation.
delete_step3: Choose Delete account (or similar wording in your language).
delete_step4: Confirm when prompted. The account is removed after confirmation.
delete_email_p: If you cannot use the app or need help, email us from the address linked to your account:
delete_data_p: When your account is deleted, we remove account-level data, including:
delete_retention_p1: Some information may be deleted later, anonymized, or kept for a limited period where required for legal obligations, fraud prevention, security, or dispute resolution. For example, comments and related content may be deleted or anonymized so they are no longer tied to you.
delete_retention_p2: Operational or technical records (such as server logs) may be retained only as long as necessary and in line with applicable law.
delete_contact_p: If you have trouble deleting your account or questions about this process, contact us at the email above and include the email address your GameSearch account uses.
